title.zh: 与伊本·西那往来的问答

alt.en: A manuscript page with dense black Arabic script, red headings and short notes in the margins.
alt.zh: 手稿页以黑色阿拉伯文密写正文，夹有红色标题，页边另有短注。

caption.en: Opening of Ibn Sina’s letter to al-Biruni, preserved in a manuscript dated 1279, fol. 3b. Princeton University Library, Islamic Manuscripts, Garrett 308Y.
caption.zh: 伊本·西那致比鲁尼书信开篇，保存于目录定年为1279年的手稿中，第3叶背面。普林斯顿大学图书馆，伊斯兰手稿，Garrett 308Y。

interpretation.en: Princeton catalogues two sequences of ten and seven questions and answers. Red headings divide the discussion; the manuscript preserves an intellectual exchange in a later copy, not in either scholar’s own handwriting.
interpretation.zh: 普林斯顿目录记载其中有两组问答，分别包含十问与七问。红色标题分隔讨论内容；这部后世抄本保存了学者间的思想交流，并非任何一位学者的亲笔。

items.creator: Ibn Sina (Avicenna); later copyist unrecorded
items.credit: Princeton University Library, Islamic Manuscripts, Garrett no. 308Y; gift of Robert Garrett, Class of 1897, 1942

note.en: The exact full IIIF manifest marks this manuscript No Known Copyright and dates it to 1279. Princeton Library claims no copyright in digital reproductions of collection material.
note.zh: 此手稿完整IIIF清单标示无已知版权，定年为1279年。普林斯顿图书馆不对馆藏的数字复制品主张版权。

transformation.en: Official 1000-pixel derivative saved unchanged; no cropping, recoloring or retouching.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方1000像素衍生图；未裁切、改色或修饰。
